title: Azure permission
description: One permission in Azure RBAC's own terms (D68): a control-plane action (Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/read) or a data-plane action (Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets/readMetadata/action). Exactly one of action or dataAction is named. It is checked at the scope of the resource a task targets: a role assignment at the resource, its resource group or the subscription grants it. An optional `scope: subscription` marks an action that is read at the subscription instead (Microsoft.Insights/eventtypes/management/values/read, Microsoft.ContainerService/locations/kubernetesVersions/read).

oneOf.title: Control-plane action
oneOf.description: An Azure Resource Manager operation as it appears in a role definition's actions, for example Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/read or Microsoft.Insights/metrics/read.

scope.description: Optional. `subscription`: the action is read at the subscription, not at the resource the task targets, so a permission check evaluates it at subscription scope (the Activity Log and the list of Kubernetes versions of a region are subscription-level reads). Absent: the scope of the target resource.

oneOf.title: Data-plane action
oneOf.description: A data-plane operation as it appears in a role definition's dataActions, for example Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/read. A data action is not granted by Reader or Contributor on the control plane. A Key Vault that uses access policies instead of Azure RBAC grants these through its access policy, which this schema does not describe.

scope.description: Optional. `subscription`: the action is read at the subscription, not at the resource the task targets, so a permission check evaluates it at subscription scope (the Activity Log and the list of Kubernetes versions of a region are subscription-level reads). Absent: the scope of the target resource.
